description: Defines the HostCache class used for caching DNS host resolution results, including nested classes for cache keys, entries, and staleness, along with methods for cache management and serialization.

classes.name: net::HostCache
classes.description: A cache for DNS host resolution results, supporting lookup, insertion, invalidation, and serialization.

classes.name: net::HostCache::Key
classes.description: Represents a unique key for cache entries based on hostname, query type, flags, source, and security.

classes.name: net::HostCache::Entry
classes.description: Stores DNS resolution results, including addresses, errors, TTL, and metadata.

classes.name: net::HostCache::EntryStaleness
classes.description: Indicates how stale a cache entry is, based on expiration and network changes.

methods.name: HostCache::Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a valid cache entry for a given key at a specific time.

methods.name: HostCache::Set
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cache entry for a given key.

methods.name: HostCache::Invalidate
methods.description: Marks all cache entries as stale due to network change.

methods.name: HostCache::GetList
methods.description: Serializes cache contents into a list for storage.

methods.name: HostCache::RestoreFromListValue
methods.description: Restores cache entries from a serialized list.
